title: contract invoke panics with "not yet implemented" on a result holding a soroban_sdk::Error and cannot pass a #[contracterror] argument

target.versions_affected: stellar-cli 30.0.1 and soroban-spec-tools 30.0.1 (main 0571268f has the same code in cmd/crates/soroban-spec-tools; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: Spec::xdr_to_json has todo!() for an scvError of spec type Error, so contract invoke panics (exit 101) while printing the result of a successful simulation when the result holds a soroban_sdk::Error in a struct field or a vec; parse_udt has no case for an error-enum UDT, so a #[contracterror] argument is refused in every form. A developer tool that cannot call such a function or show its result; no wrong value is produced, and these types are uncommon (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: contract invoke prints an Error-typed value as {"contract":1}, the form to_json gives without a spec, and encodes a #[contracterror] argument as scvError(sceContract(code))
entries.observed: No corpus entry drives stellar-cli. By hand with CLI 30.0.1 against a soroban-sdk 29.0.1 contract on a local standalone network (core 30): last (a struct with an Error field) and errs (a Vec<Error>) panic at soroban-spec-tools src/lib.rs:641 with not yet implemented after the simulation succeeds; report refuses the argument given as 1, NotFound, "NotFound" and {"contract":1}.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's runs with stellar 30.0.1 (soroban-spec-tools 30.0.1) and a contract built with soroban-sdk 29.0.1: contract invoke -- last and -- errs exit 101 with not yet implemented at src/lib.rs:641; -- report --e is refused for every form tried. The issue's standalone program on soroban-spec-tools 30.0.1 with no network: from_string("1", MyError) returns an error and xdr_to_json on the errs result panics.
evidence.expected_basis: soroban-sdk gives soroban_sdk::Error the spec type SC_SPEC_TYPE_ERROR and converts it, like a #[contracterror] enum, to and from an scvError (sceContract with the code); in soroban-sdk's test environment report(MyError::NotFound) returns 1.

reproduction.method: The runs the issue reports, made with stellar 30.0.1 and soroban-spec-tools 30.0.1 before filing on 2026-11-19: last and errs panic, and the #[contracterror] argument is refused in every form.

queries: stellar/stellar-cli: every issue and pull request, open and closed, about soroban-spec-tools, Error values or error-enum arguments
stellar/stellar-cli: every branch, for changes to cmd/crates/soroban-spec-tools

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/stellar-cli/issues/2897; this record restates the public issue.
